why: Each hook encodes an assumption about what the model cannot do reliably alone. An assumption that is not written down cannot be stress-tested, so the scaffolding can never be retired and becomes dead weight. Hooks listed here predate that requirement and carry no recorded rationale. This is a ratchet: a hook absent from this list must carry a dated 'Why this exists' header naming the limitation it compensates for. Remove a name from this list when its rationale is written; never add one.
